context: A dad jokes around with his young son over snacks
purpose: Teach: 人格/一見/ツッコミ/あぁ/何処/とかいう/しょうが/未だに

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 見ろ翔、このしょうが煎餅、一見ただのお菓子だけど、実は人格を変える力があるらしいぞ。
lines.en: Look Sho, this ginger cracker — at first glance just a snack, but supposedly it can change your personality.
lines.style: Playful dad voice, mock-serious, teasing exaggeration with warm chuckle underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えぇ、嘘だぁ。お父さん、それ未だに僕に通じると思ってるの?
lines.en: Whaat, no way. Dad, you still think that works on me?
lines.style: Bright child voice, skeptical but amused, slightly whiny protest.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: あぁ、鋭いツッコミだなぁ。さすが我が息子。
lines.en: Ohh, sharp comeback there. That's my boy.
lines.style: Warm dad chuckle, impressed and proud, slightly dramatic delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねぇ、最後のチョコ何処いった?さっきまでここにあったのに。
lines.en: Hey, where did the last chocolate go? It was right here a second ago.
lines.style: Curious child voice, mildly accusing, leaning into the question.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: さぁ、チョコの妖精とかいうやつが持って行ったんじゃないか?
lines.en: Hmm, maybe that thing called the chocolate fairy took it, huh?
lines.style: Sly dad voice, mock-innocent, barely suppressing a laugh.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 妖精じゃないよ、お父さんの口の中でしょ!
lines.en: It's not a fairy — it's inside your mouth!
lines.style: Indignant child voice, rising pitch, half laughing half protesting.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: バレたか。しょうがないなぁ、半分こにしよう。
lines.en: Busted, huh. Alright alright, let's split it in half.
lines.style: Sheepish dad voice, defeated but grinning, conciliatory tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やったー!お父さんって一見ずるいけど、優しいよね。
lines.en: Yes! Dad, you seem sneaky at first, but you're actually nice.
lines.style: Bright cheerful child voice, genuine affection, slightly teasing tone.
